# Scotland Tamils Raise (STR)

## About the Organization
Scotland Tamils Raise is the premier Tamil community and cultural organization in Scotland, United Kingdom. It connects Tamil families, students, and professionals residing across Edinburgh, Glasgow, Aberdeen, Dundee, Stirling, and Inverness.

## Mission & Purpose
- Cultural Heritage: Celebrating traditional Tamil festivals including Grand Pongal Vizha, Chithirai Tamil New Year, and Deepavali.
- Education & Language: Running weekend Tamil language, literature (Thirukkural), Carnatic music, and Bharatanatyam academies.
- Youth & Career Leadership: Providing mentorship, career development, and networking for Scottish-Tamil university students and young professionals.
- Integration & Civic Engagement: Partnering with local Scottish councils, charities, and multicultural organizations to foster strong civic ties.

## Key Event Schedule
- Grand Tamil Pongal Vizha (January) - Edinburgh Assembly Rooms
- Chithirai Tamil New Year Gala (April) - Glasgow Royal Concert Hall
- Scottish Tamil Youth & Professionals Leadership Summit (June) - University of Edinburgh
- Tamil Heritage & Literary Day (October) - Stirling

## Regional Nodes
- Edinburgh: Headquarters & Cultural Programming
- Glasgow: Western Scotland Engagement & Arts Academy
- Aberdeen: Grampian Region Community & Family Events
- Dundee: Tayside Student & Academic Network

## Membership Tiers
- Individual Membership (£25/year)
- Family Membership (£45/year)
- Student & Youth Membership (£10/year)
- Lifetime Patron Membership (£250 one-off)
